title: Sahara
description: An Army sergeant (James Belushi), his crew (Mark Lee, Paul Empson) and stragglers try to hold off a Nazi battalion at a Libyan waterhole.

title: The Beast
description: Afghan villagers use a found weapon to hunt a Soviet commander's (George Dzundza) tank trapped in a valley.

title: The Take
description: During his rehabilitation after he is shot during a heist in East L.A., an armored truck driver tracks down the man who committed the crime.

title: Godzilla
description: Nuclear testing in the South Pacific produces a giant mutated lizard that wreaks havoc upon New York City.

title: The Cable Guy
description: An act of kindness brings a jilted architect the unwanted friendship of an unbalanced cable-TV installer.

title: The Ugly Truth
description: An uptight television producer takes control of a morning show segment on modern relationships hosted by a misogynistic man.

title: Robot and Frank
description: An aging, cantankerous ex-cat burglar finds his zest for life renewed when he trains his robotic caretaker to help him commit heists.

title: Crossroads
